Bhogapuram Airport to Open by End of July, Says Official

The Bhogapuram Airport in Andhra Pradesh is expected to open by the end of July, according to a government official. The airport's construction has been ongoing for several years, and its opening is seen as a significant development for the region's economy. The airport will provide a new transportation hub for the area, reducing travel time and increasing connectivity. The government has assured that all necessary preparations are being made to ensure a smooth launch.
